description: This file provides functions for interacting with Feishu chat via the Lark SDK, including retrieving chat info, members, and user details, and registering chat tools within a plugin API.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Formats data into a JSON response with content and details.

methods.name: getChatInfo
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific chat by chat ID.

methods.name: getChatMembers
methods.description: Retrieves members of a specific chat, with pagination support.

methods.name: getFeishuMemberInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed user information for a given member ID.

methods.name: registerFeishuChatTools
methods.description: Registers Feishu chat operations as tools in the plugin API, with actions for members, info, and member info.
